newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta seen leaving up to 800,000 acres unseeded.
newsitem.headline: Alberta seen leaving up to 800,000 acres unseeded.

text.p: Alberta farmers on Tuesday were expected to leave 600,000 to 800,000 acres unseeded, Alberta Agriculture said in its weekly crop report for the week ended June 16.
Cool, wet weather throughout the spring prevented timely seeding of crops in some areas.

"Most of the unseeded acreage was intended for wheat and canola. Intended barley and oat acres were not as badly hit as producers were still seeding these crops as of last week," Wendy Boje, Alberta Agriculture crop statistician, wrote in this week's report.
Much of the unseeded land was in the central Peace River Valley as well as around Athabasca, St. Paul, Lac La Biche.
